## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Validating on 6 J anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers). Extremely small sample (n=6), high overfit risk. Not representative of general performance.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet executed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA validation on top 3 J days not yet executed)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04 winner day could become a loss under real-fills (slippage, fill quality)
   - Max drawdown: Could exceed historical BS-synthetic max_dd of 4701.52 if real-fills worsens
   - Blow-up scenario: Engine takes large losses on loser days due to poor fills or adverse execution
6. **Concentration:** If edge remains concentrated in 5/04 (as in BS-synthetic where 5/04 contributed 804.72 of 759.21 edge_capture), concentration disclosure will show top-5 days = >100% of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate
Real-fills validation must pass (diff < ±20% vs BS-synthetic on anchor days) and walk-forward OOS must show positive edge_capture with WF ratio >= 0.70.
